comment: vouchfx — injects VSCode's built-in C# TextMate grammar (source.cs) into the YAML block scalar that follows a `code:` mapping key. The `code:` field is where a `script.csharp` step carries its author C#. Boundary rule: the body is the run of lines more-indented than the `code:` key, terminating at the first non-blank line indented at or below the key (the YAML block-scalar indentation rule), which the `while` clause enforces via the captured key indentation plus one space and a lookahead for the content (so the body characters are tokenised by source.cs rather than consumed by the boundary match).

csharp-code-block.comment: Match a `code:` key whose value is a block scalar (| |- |+ > >- >+), then keep every subsequent line that is blank or more-indented than the key as embedded C#. The indicator (group 4) may carry an optional explicit indentation digit (1..9) and an optional chomping indicator (- or +) in EITHER order, so `|2-` and `>4+` are accepted as well as `|-3` and `>+1`. Capture group 1 is the key's leading indentation. The `while` clause matches the key indentation plus one space and then uses a LOOKAHEAD `(?=\s*\S)` for the content, so it consumes only the indentation (scoped as whitespace via `whileCaptures`) and leaves the body characters to be tokenised by `source.cs` — without the lookahead the first content character of every body line would be swallowed and mis-scoped.
